term.name: expression_rule_context
term.definition: A rule's context that is no XSLT pattern but a valid XPath expression ((//item)[1], ../x): it matches the nodes the expression selects from the start nodes (the instance root, a phase's from nodes, a subordinate document's root), compiled as the predicate pattern .[. intersect $s:context-K] over a global holding the expression's value ()
